verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs show it holds packages for up to 10 days and can forward physical items, including internationally for a per-shipment fee plus postage. The evidence never says it accepts packages from all major carriers, and it does not document consolidation or in-person pickup. missing for 10: acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, local pickup option, independent corroboration of package handling

support.subject: As a digital nomad, the address accepts packages from all major carriers and can consolidate or hold them for pickup or forwarding

citations.quote: Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages
easily forward physical items wherever you need them
